subject: Outstanding VAT split + accelerated recovery path for Glimmer Systems
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Hayes <finance@glimmersys.com>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@glimmersys.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T08:22:00-05:00
Subject: Reminder: INV-2026-09 — outstanding balance + VAT posture

Hi Caroline —

Quick note to follow up on invoice INV-2026-09 (attached). The invoice is 48 days past due and the outstanding amount is EUR 72,400 (includes EUR 12,400 VAT). We haven’t received a payment or a remit notice yet. Can you confirm whether Glimmer is applying the reverse-charge (VAT) for this invoice or if you need Redwood to issue an amended invoice with VAT shifted?

If reverse-charge is the plan, we’ll need a signed VAT certificate or a written confirmation from your AP team so we can reconcile the VAT lines and close the invoice on our side. If you’re unable to provide that this week, please propose a payment date or a short staged schedule so we can avoid escalations.

Attachments: [INV-2026-09-GLIMMER.pdf (invoice, 2 pages)]

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
phone: +1 415-555-0191
From: Caroline Hayes <finance@glimmersys.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@glimmersys.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:03:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Reminder: INV-2026-09 — outstanding balance + VAT posture

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the reminder and the invoice. We’ve been holding payment while our tax team confirms whether the reverse-charge applies under the current engagement (there was ambiguity around the place-of-supply for the consulting work). I don’t have the signed certificate yet — our tax counsel is reviewing and expects to confirm by end of next week (latest 2026-11-20).

In the meantime, can you share a breakdown showing the net amount without VAT and the net amount if we apply reverse-charge? Our controller wants line-level clarity before signing anything. Also, we may need a 30-day staged payment if customs/withholding requires extra approvals.

Apologies for the delay — we’re trying to avoid re-invoicing.

Best,
Caroline
Caroline Hayes
CFO, Glimmer Systems
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Glimmer — VAT hold + proposed dunning path

Ava —

Seeing Caroline’s reply. Given this is 48 days outstanding and the VAT portion is uncertain, recommend we: 
- Move to an accelerated dunning cadence: payment reminder + formal notice in 3 business days, final notice in 10 days.
- Offer a two‑installment payment plan (50% now / 50% in 30 days) conditioned on receiving the VAT confirmation within 7 business days.
- If no firm date from Glimmer by 2026-11-23, escalate to exec touchpoint (Laura + our CFO) and consider pausing API keys per contract after legal review.

I attached a short payment-plan template and our VAT guidance doc you can send. Keep communications polite — this is a strategic customer but we need commitment.

Attachments: [glimmer-payment-plan-proposal.pdf (proposal, 1 page), VAT-reverse-charge-guidance.pdf (reference, 3 pages)]

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Hayes <finance@glimmersys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Tim Cho <tim.cho@glimmersys.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T13:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Reminder: INV-2026-09 — outstanding balance + VAT posture

Caroline —

Thanks for the update. I’ve attached a simple line-level split (net / VAT) and a one-page payment-plan proposal Marcus shared. Key points: if Glimmer can confirm reverse-charge in writing by COB 2026-11-23, we’ll accept a two-part payment (50% by 2026-11-30; remainder by 2026-12-30) and will avoid reissuing the invoice. If the VAT confirmation comes later than that date, the invoice will need amendment which may delay settlement further.

If helpful, Laura (our VP of Customer Success) and I are available for a 30-minute CFO call to resolve the tax posture and sign off the plan.

Quoted for context: 
> On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 09:03 +0000 Caroline Hayes <finance@glimmersys.com> wrote:
> > Thanks for the reminder and the invoice. We’ve been holding payment while our tax team confirms whether the reverse-charge applies...

Attachments: [INV-net-vat-breakdown.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet), glimmer-payment-plan-proposal.pdf]

Appreciate it —
Ava
From: Caroline Hayes <finance@glimmersys.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@glimmersys.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T14:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Reminder: INV-2026-09 — outstanding balance + VAT posture

Ava / Laura —

Apologies for the back-and-forth. Our tax counsel confirmed today that reverse-charge applies but we need a brief certificate (EU VAT proof) and a signed declaration from our controller before we can remit the full net amount. We can do the following: 

1) Wire 50% of the NET amount (EUR 30,000) by 2026-11-30 if Redwood can confirm you’ll withhold the VAT line pending receipt of our certificate.
2) Provide the signed VAT certificate and remit the 2nd 50% by 2026-12-20.

We’ll upload the certificate to the shared Drive folder and include a copy in the payment remittance. Link to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Glimmer-VAT-Evidence

If Redwood agrees, I’ll have Tim process the partial wire and loop in our procurement for the second installment. Appreciate the flexibility — we value the relationship and want a clean tax trail.

Thanks,
Caroline

--
Caroline Hayes
CFO, Glimmer Systems
[Attachment: Glimmer_VAT_certificate.pdf (to be uploaded)]
